title: SRE weekly reliability prep digest — 1:1 and sync notes

Paging trends (10m): top routes, services with rising pages
Incidents triage (15m): review top 3 incidents + root cause hypotheses

notes:

- Consider temporary traffic shaping: cap long-sequence requests to dedicated pool until memprof is addressed. Ops + platform engineering alignment needed.
- Flag for product: customers noticed higher latency in EU for heavy prompts (ticket threads linked). We should coordinate comms if breach likely.
- For 1:1 with Marcus: ask about infra to run memprof with production-scale sequences and whether we can attach eBPF heap snapshots.

- Routing precedence bug was triggered by overlapping canary tags; simulation harness should be able to fail this quickly.

Questions to surface:

- Product: are any canaries scheduled this week that might intersect with dedicated pool changes?
